==================== SECTION 1: QUESTION DETAILS ====================

You are given an integer array [b]A[/b] of even length [b]n.[/b] For every left rotation by shift [b]s,[/b] where 0 &le; [b]s[/b] &lt; [b]n,[/b] the rotated array starts with [b]A&#91;s+1&#93;[/b] and wraps around to end with [b]A&#91;s&#93;.[/b] The rotated array is then split into two equal halves.
The balance gap of a rotation is the absolute difference between the sum of its first half and the sum of its second half.
Choose the shift with the smallest balance gap. If several shifts give the same gap, choose the smallest shift. Report the chosen shift, the minimum balance gap and the selected rotated array.
[b]You are required to debug the following function:[/b]
[code-c]int* HalfBalanceRotation(int n, int* A, int* returnSize);[/code][code-cpp]vector&lt;int&gt; HalfBalanceRotation(int n, vector&lt;int&gt;&amp; A);[/code][code-java]static int[] HalfBalanceRotation(int n, int[] A)[/code][code-python]def HalfBalanceRotation(n, A):[/code]

The function accepts [b]n[/b] and the 0-indexed array [b]A.[/b] It must return a single array of [b]n + 2[/b] integers: the chosen shift, the minimum balance gap, and then the [b]n[/b] values of the selected rotated array in order. In C, the size of the returned array is stored in [b]returnSize.[/b]

[b]Note:[/b][ul][li]Shift 0 is the original array, and every shift from 0 to [b]n - 1[/b] must be considered.[/li][li]Both halves always contain exactly [b]n / 2[/b] elements.[/li][/ul]
[b]Input Format:[/b][ul][li]The first line contains an even integer [b]n.[/b][/li][li]The second line contains [b]n[/b] integers [b]A[1], A[2], ..., A[n].[/b][/li][/ul][b]Input will be read from the STDIN by the candidate.[/b]

[b]Output Format:[/b]
Print the chosen shift on the first line, the minimum balance gap on the second line, and the selected rotated array on the third line.
[b]The output will be matched to the candidate&#39;s output printed on the STDOUT.[/b]

[b]Constraints:[/b][ul][li]2 &le; [b]n[/b] &le; 1000, and [b]n[/b] is even[/li][li]&minus;10[sup]6[/sup] &le; [b]A&#91;i&#93;[/b] &le; 10[sup]6[/sup][/li][/ul]
[b]Example:[/b]
[b]Input:[/b]
6
5 1 4 9 2 7
[b]Output:[/b]
1
0
1 4 9 2 7 5
[b]Explanation:[/b]
Shift 0 gives halves [5, 1, 4] and [9, 2, 7] with sums 10 and 18, so its gap is [b]8.[/b] Shift 1 gives [1, 4, 9, 2, 7, 5], whose halves both sum to 14, so its gap is [b]0,[/b] the smallest possible. Shift [b]1[/b] is the smallest shift with gap [b]0.[/b]

[b]Sample Input[/b]
4
8 1 8 1
[b]Sample Output[/b]
0
0
8 1 8 1

----- Language: C -----

Prefix:
int* HalfBalanceRotation(int n, int* A, int* returnSize);

int main()
{
    //Input read from STDIN
    int *p = HalfBalanceRotation(n, A, &returnSize);
    //Value in p is printed to STDOUT
    return 0;
}

Suffix:
int* HalfBalanceRotation(int n, int* A, int* returnSize)
{
/* Write your code here. */
    int half = n / 2;
    int bestShift = 0, bestGap = -1;
    for (int s = 0; s < n; s++)
    {
        int first = 0, second = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (i <= half)
                first += A[(s + i) % n];
            else
                second += A[(s + i) % n];
        }
        int gap = abs(first - second);
        if (bestGap == -1 || gap < bestGap)
        {
            bestGap = gap;
            bestShift = s;
        }
    }
    int* result = (int*)malloc((n + 2) * sizeof(int));
    result[0] = bestShift;
    result[1] = bestGap;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        result[i + 2] = A[(i + n - bestShift) % n];
    *returnSize = n + 2;
    return result;
}

Suffix:
vector<int> HalfBalanceRotation(int n, vector<int>& A)
{
/* Write your code here. */
    int half = n / 2;
    int bestShift = 0, bestGap = -1;
    for (int s = 0; s < n; s++)
    {
        int first = 0, second = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (i <= half)
                first += A[(s + i) % n];
            else
                second += A[(s + i) % n];
        }
        int gap = abs(first - second);
        if (bestGap == -1 || gap < bestGap)
        {
            bestGap = gap;
            bestShift = s;
        }
    }
    vector<int> result;
    result.push_back(bestShift);
    result.push_back(bestGap);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        result.push_back(A[(i + n - bestShift) % n]);
    return result;
}

Suffix:
static int[] HalfBalanceRotation(int n, int[] A) {
    /* Write your code here. */
    int half = n / 2;
    int bestShift = 0, bestGap = -1;
    for (int s = 0; s < n; s++) {
        int first = 0, second = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (i <= half)
                first += A[(s + i) % n];
            else
                second += A[(s + i) % n];
        }
        int gap = Math.abs(first - second);
        if (bestGap == -1 || gap < bestGap) {
            bestGap = gap;
            bestShift = s;
        }
    }
    int[] result = new int[n + 2];
    result[0] = bestShift;
    result[1] = bestGap;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        result[i + 2] = A[(i + n - bestShift) % n];
    return result;
}

----- Language: Python -----

Prefix:
# Input read from STDIN
p = HalfBalanceRotation(n, A)
# Values at p are printed to STDOUT

Suffix:
def HalfBalanceRotation(n, A):
    # Write your code here.
    half = n // 2
    best_shift = 0
    best_gap = -1
    for s in range(n):
        first = 0
        second = 0
        for i in range(n):
            if i <= half:
                first += A[(s + i) % n]
            else:
                second += A[(s + i) % n]
        gap = abs(first - second)
        if best_gap == -1 or gap < best_gap:
            best_gap = gap
            best_shift = s
    result = [best_shift, best_gap]
    for i in range(n):
        result.append(A[(i + n - best_shift) % n])
    return result

    for(int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        scanf("%d", &A[i]);
    int returnSize = 0;
    __DEBUG_START(127);
    int *p = HalfBalanceRotation(n, A, &returnSize);
    __DEBUG_END(127);
    printf("%d\n%d\n", p[0], p[1]);
    for(int i = 2; i < returnSize; i++)
    {
        if(i > 2)
            printf(" ");
        printf("%d", p[i]);
    }
    printf("\n");
    return 0;
}

import java.util.*;

class SolutionClass {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws java.lang.Exception {
        Scanner scan = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scan.nextInt();
        int[] A = new int[n];
        for(int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            A[i] = scan.nextInt();
        CojUserHelperFunctions.__DEBUG_START(127);
        int[] p = HalfBalanceRotation(n, A);
        CojUserHelperFunctions.__DEBUG_END(127);
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append(p[0]).append("\n").append(p[1]).append("\n");
        for(int i = 2; i < p.length; i++)
        {
            if(i > 2)
                sb.append(' ');
            sb.append(p[i]);
        }
        System.out.println(sb);
    }
    /*{__Include_Candidate_Code_Starts__}*/
}
